Grendel.t: Grendel's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Grimoire.t: This weapon is acquired during the Whispers in the Walls quest at max rank with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Grinlok.t: The Grinlok's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Guandao.t: The Guandao's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Gunsen.t: The Gunsen's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Gyre.t: Gyre's component and main blueprints can be acquired from The Holdfasts bounties on the Chrysalith.

Haalvu.t: Haalvu can be purchased during Epoch Operation: Taubound from Praghasa for 150 Moonflesh. m. m. ET (UTC -4), on July 11th, 2026. It comes with a free Weapon Slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Halikar.t: The Halikar's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Halikar Wraith.t: The Halikar Wraith can be potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 350,000 Credits and 450. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Harmony.t: Harmony's blueprint is obtained from Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, at a 5% drop rate.

Harpak.t: The Harpak's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Harrow.t: Harrow's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Chains of Harrow quest.

Hate.t: The Hate's blueprint is dropped by the (Shadow) Stalker. It is also included in the What Stalker? bundle for 725 Platinum in the market.

Heat Dagger.t: The Heat Dagger's blueprint can be bought from Nightwave Offerings for 50x Cred

Heat Sword.t: The Heat Sword blueprint is rewarded upon completion of the Once Awake Quest.

Hek.t: The Hek's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Heliocor.t: The Heliocor's blueprint can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for 75,000 Standing 75,000.

Helios.t: Helios can be researched from the Energy Lab in the Dojo. Note that acquiring Helios requires two open Companion slots: one for Helios itself and one for the Deconstructor robotic weapon it comes with.

Helminth Charger.t: The Kubrow Incubator screen, with Helminth Cyst section visible.

Helstrum.t: The Helstrum's blueprint can be purchased from Legs in Fortuna for 10,000 Standing 10,000, requiring Rank 5 - Old Mate with Solaris United. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

Hema.t: The Hema's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Hespar.t: Hespar's main blueprint can be acquired from Tier 4 Chrysalith Bounties. The blade blueprint drops from Void Armageddon. The handle blueprint drops from Void Cascade. All components but the main blueprint can be traded.

Higasa.t: Higasa's blueprint and components can be obtained from Shrine Defense on Saya's Visions, Earth. Access requires completion of Saya's Vigil and Once Awake.

Hikou.t: The Hikou's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Hildryn.t: Hildryn's main blueprint can be purchased from Little Duck for 5,000 Standing 5,000 upon reaching Rank 2 - Agent with Vox Solaris. Hildryn's component blueprints can be acquired from Exploiter Orb.

Hind.t: The Hind's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Hirudo.t: The Hirudo's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Huras Kubrow.t: The player must have completed the Howl of the Kubrow quest in order to have an operating Incubator on the Orbiter, as well as have acquired a Kubrow Egg from Kubrow Dens on the Grineer Forest tilesets of Earth and a built Incubator Power Core whose blueprint can be obtained from the Market.

Hydroid.t: Hydroid's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Hydroid's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating from Councilor Vay Hek on Oro, Earth. The mission requires Mastery Rank 5 to enter.

Hystrix.t: The Hystrix's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Ignis.t: The Ignis's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Ignis Wraith.t: The blueprint drops from Abandoned Derelict Caches in Grineer-controlled Veil Proxima missions.

Imperator.t: A built Imperator is automatically acquired upon claiming the Odonata Archwing from the Foundry during The Archwing quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Imperator Vandal.t: The Imperator Vandal was awarded during the Operation: Eyes of Blight event for obtaining 15 (PC)/10 (PS4/XB1) Battle Points, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Inaros.t: Inaros's main and component blueprints are obtained from the Sands of Inaros quest. The quest blueprint is tradeable from another player, or purchasable from Baro Ki'Teer for 100 + 25,000 Credits.

Innodem.t: Innodem's main blueprint is purchased from Cavalero of The Holdfasts at Rank 1 - Fallen for 5,500 Standing 5,500. The blueprint can be traded.

Itzal.t: The Itzal's main and component blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo. The blueprints can only be purchased after completion of The Archwing quest.

Ivara.t: Ivara's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Ivara's component blueprints are acquired from Spy missions (including Nightmare Mode) depending on mission level. Alerts and Sorties do not award identified items and therefore are exempt.

Jade.t: Jade's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of the Jade Shadows quest. Her component blueprints are obtained from Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, at a 5% drop rate.

Karyst.t: The Karyst's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Kaszas.t: The Kaszas's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Its parts can be purchased from various Syndicates. All parts, except for the blueprint, are tradeable.

Kestrel.t: The Kestrel's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Khora.t: Khora's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Khora's component blueprints are acquired from standard Sanctuary Onslaught (not the Elite variant). Every two stages is a rotation, following the standard A-A-B-C pattern.

Knell.t: The Knell's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Korrudo.t: Korrudo's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating a Tusk Thumper Bull or Tusk Thumper Doma in the Plains of Eidolon.

Korumm.t: Korumm's blueprint is acquired from Narmer Bounties after completion of The New War.

Koumei.t: Koumei's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Shrine Defense on Saya's Visions, Earth. Access requires completion of Saya's Vigil and Once Awake.

Lato Vandal.t: 0 (2013-03-18)). It originally had no rank restriction, so anyone who logged in during the Closed Beta could acquire it, regardless of time spent playing the game.

Latron Wraith.t: This weapon was awarded during the Operation: Cryotic Front event to players who extracted 3000 Cryotic in a single mission, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Lavos.t: Lavos's main and component blueprints are available from Father with Entrati standing. The main blueprint requires players to be at Rank 2 - Acquaintance, while component blueprints require Rank 3 - Associate.

Lecta.t: The Lecta's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Saturn to Uranus Junction.

Lenz.t: The Lenz's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Lesion.t: The Lesion's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Lex.t: A built Lex can be purchased from the Market for 50,000 Credits.

Limbo.t: Limbo's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Component blueprints are awarded from The Limbo Theorem quest, obtainable by completing the Europa Junction on Jupiter.

Loki.t: Loki's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Loki's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating the Hyena Pack on Psamathe, Neptune.

Lorak.t: After completing The Old Peace, players can visit Marie Leroux in the Sanctum Anatomica to purchase each focus school's Tektolyst Artifact. Players must have the respective focus school unlocked before being able to purchase the school's Tektolyst Artifact.

Machete.t: First acquisition is through Daily Tribute. Then the Machete's blueprint can be bought from Cephalon Simaris offerings for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Machete Wraith.t: The Machete Wraith is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 250,000 Credits and 410. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Mag.t: Mag is one of the three starter Warframes, alongside Excalibur and Volt, during Awakening. Mag's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Mag's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating The Sergeant on Iliad, Phobos.

Magistar.t: The Magistar's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Magnus.t: The Magnus's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Mandonel.t: Mandonel's main blueprint is awarded from Sanctum Anatomica Bounties as a rare drop.

Mara Detron.t: The Mara Detron can be purchased from Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 200,000 Credits and 500. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Marelok.t: The Marelok's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Masseter.t: The Masseter's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Mausolon.t: A built Mausolon is automatically acquired upon claiming any Necramech, either the Voidrig or the Bonewidow, from the Foundry. Functioning as their default weapon option, the Mausolon also comes with the necessary Gravimag already pre-installed.

Medjay Predasite.t: To obtain a Predasite as a companion, players must acquire one through Revivification with Son in the Necralisk, Deimos.

Mesa.t: Mesa's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Mewan.t: The Mewan blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for 1,000 Standing 1,000.

Mios.t: The Mios's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Mirage.t: Mirage's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Component blueprints are awarded at the end of each mission for the Hidden Messages quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 25,000 Standing 25,000.

Mire.t: The Mire's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Pluto to Eris Junction.

Miter.t: Miter's main blueprint and components can be obtained from the dual boss team Lech Kril and Captain Vor on Exta, Ceres.

Mk1-Bo.t: Mk1-Bo can be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mk1-Braton.t: Mk1-Braton be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits. It can be sold for 2,500 Credits.

Mk1-Furax.t: A built Mk1-Furax can be bought from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mk1-Furis.t: A built Mk1-Furis can be bought in the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mk1-Kunai.t: Mk1-Kunai can be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mk1-Paris.t: Mk1-Paris can be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mk1-Strun.t: A built Mk1-Strun can be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Morgha.t: The Morgha main blueprint can be acquired by reaching Rank 3 - Clearance: Odima with the Necraloid. The main blueprint is offered as a rank up reward, but Loid sells additional main blueprints for 8,000 Standing 8,000.

Multron.t: The Multron is automatically acquired upon obtaining Oxylus. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

Mutalist Cernos.t: The Mutalist Cernos's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Mutalist Quanta.t: The Mutalist Quanta's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Narin.t: Narin's main and component blueprints can be obtained as mission rewards aboard the Zariman Ten Zero.

Nataruk.t: Nataruk is given upon completion of The New War, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. Additional copies of Nataruk can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Nautilus.t: Nautilus' blueprint and components can be found in Points of Interest and Arva Vector Defense from Rotation B+C in Neptune Proxima missions. All parts can be traded between players.

Needlenose.t: The Needlenose blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Primo with the Ventkids and buying it from Roky for 15,000 Standing 15,000. It can also be selected as a standing increase reward when ranking up to Primo.

Nekros.t: Nekros' main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Nekros' component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Lephantis on Magnacidium, Deimos.

Nepheri.t: Nepheri's blueprint is acquired from Narmer Bounties after completion of The New War.

Nezha.t: Nezha's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Nidri.t: After completing The Old Peace, players can visit Marie Leroux in the Sanctum Anatomica to purchase each focus school's Tektolyst Artifact. Players must have the respective focus school unlocked before being able to purchase the school's Tektolyst Artifact.

Nidus.t: Nidus' main blueprint is acquired from The Glast Gambit quest; additional main blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 50,000 Standing 50,000.

Nikana.t: The Nikana's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Ninkondi.t: The Ninkondi's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Nokko.t: Nokko's main and component blueprints are acquired from Deepmines Bounties as an uncommon and rare drop. Access requires completion of The New War.

Nova.t: Nova's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Nova's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating the Raptors on Naamah, Europa.

Nukor.t: The Nukor's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Nunchasa.t: Nunchasa's blueprints can be purchased from Cephalon Melica on Yuvan Peak, Earth, or the Chrysalith, Zariman Ten Zero, for Entropic Kuva, which are dropped by Entropic Eximus in the Zariman.

Nyx.t: Nyx's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Nyx's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Phorid on assassination missions that appear during an Infested Invasion.

Oberon.t: Oberon's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Oberon's component blueprints are obtained from Earth Proxima (Neuroptics & Systems) and Saturn Proxima (Chassis) Points of Interest in Empyrean missions.

Obex.t: The Obex's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Octavia.t: Octavia's main blueprint and the Mandachord are acquired from the Octavia's Anthem quest. The Chassis blueprint is rewarded from the Music Puzzle on Lua. The Neuroptics blueprint is rewarded from Rotation C of Terrorem (Survival), Deimos.

Ocucor.t: The Ocucor's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Odonata.t: The Odonata's main and component blueprints are obtainable during The Archwing quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris; 50,000 Standing 50,000 for component blueprints and 100,000 Standing 100,000 for main blueprint.

Ogris.t: The Ogris's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Ohma.t: The Ohma's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Okina.t: The Okina's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Onorix.t: The Onorix's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Its parts can be purchased from various Syndicates. All parts, except for the blueprint, are tradeable.

Onos.t: Onos's blueprint can be obtained from Disruption Armatus on Deimos, whose access requires completion of The Deadlock Protocol and Whispers in the Walls, from Rotation B.

Ooltha.t: The Ooltha blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for 1,000 Standing 1,000.

Opticor.t: The Opticor's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Opticor Vandal.t: This weapon is awarded for earning 100 points from the recurring Thermia Fractures event that was first introduced in Operation: Buried Debts, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Oraxia.t: Oraxia's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Isleweaver in Duviri. Access requires completion of The Hex Quest.

Orion & Sirius.t: Sirius & Orion's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. Their component blueprints are obtained from Scoria's Angel or The Kuva Wytch on Uranus Proxima via Empyrean Railjack.

Orthos.t: The Orthos's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Orvius.t: The blueprint is rewarded on completion of The War Within. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000. The Blade drops from Kuva Guardians, while the Disc drops from Kuva Jesters.

Oxylus.t: Oxylus's blueprint can be acquired from The Business in Fortuna for 20,000 Standing 20,000 after reaching Rank 5 - Old Mate with Solaris United.

Pandero.t: The Pandero's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Pangolin Sword.t: The Pangolin Sword's blueprint can be bought from Nightwave Offerings for 50x Cred

Panthera.t: The Panthera's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Panzer Vulpaphyla.t: Vulpaphylas are acquired through Revivification with Son in the Necralisk, Deimos.

Paracesis.t: The weapon blueprint is given to the player upon completing the Chimera Prologue quest.

Paracyst.t: The Paracyst's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Paris.t: The Paris's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Pathocyst.t: Pathocyst's main blueprint and components can be obtained from defeating Zealoid Prelate on Exequias, Deimos. All parts are tradeable between players.

Pennant.t: The Pennant's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating Blite Captain, Glacik Commander, Lektro Commander, or Pyr Captain in Empyrean missions (at Kasio's Rest on Saturn Proxima, Flexa in Veil Proxima, or sometimes Korms Belt in Earth Proxima).

Penta.t: The Penta's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Jupiter to Saturn Junction.

Perigale.t: Perigale's blueprint and components can be obtained from Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within; the blueprint comes from Rotation A, while the Barrel, Receiver, and Stock come from Rotation B.

Phaedra.t: The Phaedra's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Its parts can be purchased from various Syndicates, with the receiver also being rare drop from Archwing Exterminate on Montes, Venus and Syrtis, Mars.

Phage.t: The Phage's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Phantasma.t: The Phantasma's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Pharaoh Predasite.t: Predasites are acquired through Revivification with Son in the Necralisk, Deimos.

Phenmor.t: Phenmor's main blueprint is purchased from Cavalero of The Holdfasts at Rank 2 - Watcher for 6,000 Standing 6,000 Standing. The blueprint can be traded.

Plague Keewar.t: Plague Keewar is obtainable from limited-time events: Operation: Plague Star sold Plague Keewar from Nakak for 2,000 Standing 2,000 + 3,500 Credits, requiring Rank 3 - Champion with Operational Supply.

Plague Kripath.t: Plague Kripath is obtainable from limited-time events: Operation: Plague Star sold Plague Kripath from Nakak for 2,000 Standing 2,000 + 3,500 Credits, requiring Rank 3 - Champion with Operational Supply.

Plasma Sword.t: The Plasma Sword's blueprint can be bought from Nightwave Offerings for 50x Cred

Plinx.t: The Plinx's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Uriel.t: Uriel's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of The Old Peace quest. His component blueprints are obtained from Roathe's Oblivion on Infernium 21 of The Descendia.

Valkyr.t: Valkyr's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Valkyr's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Alad V on Themisto, Jupiter.

Vasca Kavat.t: To breed a Vasca Kavat, players must first complete the Howl of the Kubrow quest to unlock the Incubator and install the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment.

Vastilok.t: The Vastilok is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 325,000 Credits and 550. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Vasto.t: The Vasto blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Vauban.t: Vauban's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Vauban's component blueprints can be bought from the Nightwave Offerings for 25x Cred each, for a total of 75x Cred.

Vaykor Hek.t: The Vaykor Hek can be acquired by reaching the Rank of General with Steel Meridian, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Vaykor Hek cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to General rank.

Vaykor Marelok.t: The Vaykor Marelok can be acquired by reaching the Rank of General with Steel Meridian, and spending 100,000 Standing 100,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Vaykor Marelok cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to General rank.

Vaykor Sydon.t: The Vaykor Sydon can be acquired by reaching the Rank of General with Steel Meridian, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Vaykor Sydon cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to General rank.

Vectis.t: The Vectis's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Veldt.t: The Veldt's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Velocitus.t: The Velocitus's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo. Its parts can be purchased from various Syndicates. All parts, except for the blueprint, are tradeable.

Velox.t: The Velox's component parts can be acquired from within the Granum Void; the Barrel from Rotation C, the Receiver from Rotation C of Extended Granum Void. The main blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Venato.t: The Venato's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Venka.t: The Venka's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Verdilac.t: Verdilac's blueprint is acquired from Narmer Bounties after completion of The New War.

Verglas.t: The Verglas is automatically acquired upon obtaining Nautilus. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

Vericres.t: The Vericres is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 200,000 Credits and 410. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance. m. m.

Veritux.t: A built Veritux is automatically acquired upon claiming the Odonata Archwing from the Foundry during The Archwing quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Vermisplicer.t: The blueprint for the chamber can be bought from Father for 500 Standing 500 at Rank 0 with Entrati.

Vesper 77.t: Vesper 77's main blueprint is awarded from Tier 4 Höllvania Central Mall Bounties as a rare drop, requiring the completion of The Hex to access. The Barrel, Receiver, and Handle are awarded from Höllvania Legacyte Harvest and Hell-Scrub.

Vexoric.t: After completing The Old Peace, players can visit Marie Leroux in the Sanctum Anatomica to purchase each focus school's Tektolyst Artifact. Players must have the respective focus school unlocked before being able to purchase the school's Tektolyst Artifact.

Vinquibus.t: Vinquibus' main and component blueprints are obtained from Roathe's Oblivion on Infernium 21 of The Descendia, available after completing The Old Peace quest.

Viper.t: The Viper's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Viper Wraith.t: The Viper Wraith can be potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 75,000 Credits and 400. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Vitrica.t: The Vitrica's blueprint was obtained after defeating Nihil in Nightwave: Series 3, Episode 5.

Vizier Predasite.t: Predasites are acquired through Revivification with Son in the Necralisk, Deimos.

Voidrig.t: Completion of Heart of Deimos will reward all main and component blueprints for free.

Volnus.t: The Volnus's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Volt.t: Volt is one of the three starter Warframes, alongside Excalibur and Mag, during Awakening. Volt's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Voruna.t: Voruna's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation C of Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within.

Vulcax.t: The Vulcax's blueprint can be purchased from Legs in Fortuna for 10,000 Standing 10,000, requiring Rank 5 - Old Mate with Solaris United. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

Vulkar.t: The Vulkar's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Mars to Ceres Junction.

Vulkar Wraith.t: The Vulkar Wraith is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 300,000 Credits and 450. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Vulklok.t: The Vulklok is automatically acquired upon obtaining Diriga. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

War.t: The War's blueprint is dropped by either the Protector Stalker or the Shadow Stalker. It is also included in the Hunhow's Gift bundle for 516 Platinum in the market.

Wisp.t: Wisp's main and components blueprints are acquired from defeating the Ropalolyst on The Ropalolyst, Jupiter.

Wolf Sledge.t: Wolf Sledge's main blueprint and components can be acquired as random drops after defeating the Wolf of Saturn Six. All parts are tradeable between players.

Wrath.t: Wrath's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Scoria's Angel, Uranus Proxima, as well as a Pride Blade from The Kuva Wytch. Access requires completion of Jade Shadows: Constellations.

Wukong.t: Wukong's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Wyrm.t: Wyrm's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Note that acquiring Wyrm requires two open Companion slots: one for Wyrm itself and one for the Laser Rifle robotic weapon it comes with.

Xaku.t: Xaku's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Heart of Deimos quest.

Xoris.t: The blueprint, core, handle, and blade are all obtained during The Deadlock Protocol. Additional blueprints and parts can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000 and 15,000 Standing 15,000 respectively.

Yareli.t: Yareli's main blueprint is acquired by completing The Waverider quest. Component blueprints are acquired through Research inside the Ventkids' Bash Lab within the Clan Dojo.

Zakti.t: The Zakti's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Zarr.t: The Zarr's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Zenistar.t: The Zenistar is exclusive to the Daily Tribute system. It will become available every 200 days, beginning at day 100, until chosen as the Milestone reward. It comes with a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Zenith.t: The Zenith is exclusive to the Daily Tribute system. It will become available every 200 days, beginning at day 100, until chosen as the Milestone reward. The weapon comes with its own weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Zephyr.t: Zephyr's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Zhuge.t: The Zhuge's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Zylok.t: The Zylok is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 200,000 Credits and 500. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Zymos.t: Zymos is acquired by reaching Rank 1 - Stranger with the Entrati. Father sells the main blueprint for 2,000 Standing 2,000 and component blueprints for 1,000 Standing 1,000; a total of 4,000 Standing 4,000 is needed for all parts.
